title: curie build --repo-runner --json
description: The `curie build --repo-runner` receipt (ADR 0216): the pushed repository runner image as the Helm values `runner` block of `factory.bindings[].repos[].runner`, ready to paste, plus the platform runner it was built on, the catalog version and the path of the tool manifest inside the image.

tools.description: The selected catalog tools, in catalog order.

image.description: The pushed image index: `<registry>/curie-repo-runner:r-<16 hex>@sha256:<64 hex>`.

base.description: The platform runner's manifest digest the image was built on.

platformDigests.description: Each platform's manifest digest inside the pushed index.

dockerfile.description: The operator Dockerfile, relative to the input file's directory. Omitted when none was declared.

probes.description: The declared extra probes. Omitted when none were declared.

platform_runner.description: The digest-pinned platform runner reference the image was built on.

catalog_version.description: The tool catalog version the image was built from.

manifest_path.description: Where the probe manifest lives inside the image.
